intro.t: In the last minute of Part 3, you have to decide together. You don't have to agree, but you have to try. Six ways to get there.

close.t: Well done. Remember: compare, suggest, then check that your partner agrees.

reels.note: "Probably" keeps it open for your partner.

ex.t: {I'd probably choose} finding information, because we use it every single day.
ex.q: Thank you. Now you have about a minute to decide which one is the most useful for teenagers.
ex.scene: How useful are these for teenagers? · learning online · keeping in touch with friends · finding information · being creative · staying healthy

ex.t: {I'd probably choose} giving lessons. It's well paid and it's good experience.
ex.q: Thank you. Now you have about a minute to decide which would be the best way for a teenager to earn money.
